subject: Temporary credit extension request + proposed milestone invoicing schedule
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmerobotics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmerobotics.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary Net60 + credit increase for Q4 ramp

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our side as we ramp for Q4. We’ve had a short delay on Series C tranche timing (expected close pushed by two weeks) which is creating a temporary working capital gap. We’d like to request a temporary extension to Net60 for the next two invoices and a short-term increase to our credit cap from $200,000 to $350,000 while our funding closes.

Context:
- We expect the funding to clear by mid-December; this would only be for invoices dated Nov–Dec.
- Current outstanding balance: $42,150 (invoice AR-3342, due Nov 20).
- We can provide a purchase order for the quarter and a letter from our CFO confirming the funding timeline.

Can Redwood approve a temporary Net60 + $350k cap while we provide the supporting docs? If not, what alternatives would you recommend (staggered invoices, partial upfront, etc.)?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Finance
Acme Robotics

Attachments: Acme_ACR-2026-credit_request.pdf (credit request letter)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 + credit increase for Q4 ramp

Hi Priya — thanks for the context and for sending the credit letter. I copied Dylan (account lead) and Evelyn (finance ops) so we can coordinate internally.

Short answer: we can consider a conditional, time-boxed extension. Proposed approach to minimize risk while helping you through the gap: 

1) Staged milestone invoicing for the Nov/Dec billing cycle: 40% upfront (invoice on PO receipt), 30% after deployment milestone A (target 30 days), 30% at project completion (target 60 days).
2) Temporary credit ceiling increase to $350k pending receipt of: PO for Q4 (signed), the CFO letter you referenced, and a quick credit check.
3) If the PO/letter arrive within 3 business days, we can approve Net45 for the first month with Net60 honored for the second month (i.e., a hybrid to ease cashflow).

I’m attaching our milestone invoice template and the current Redwood standard terms to make sure procurement has the right paperwork. Evelyn — can you run the provisional credit check and advise on timing for the increase?

If Acme prefers a straight Net60 instead of staged invoices, we’ll need an expedited credit policy exception and an exec signoff (Dylan and I can escalate).

Next steps:
- Priya: confirm whether Acme will issue the PO this week and send the CFO letter.
- Evelyn: run provisional review and reply with recommended limit/conditions.
- Dylan: if we need an SLA/exec approval path, please flag.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Milestone_Invoice_Template.xlsx, Redwood_Standard_SAAS_Terms_v3.pdf
From: Acme Robotics Procurement <procurement@acmerobotics.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmerobotics.com>, Markus Brandt <markus.brandt@financepartners.co>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: PO AR-7789 and signed SOW for Q4 services

Hi Lauren — attached is PO AR-7789 for $250,000 and the signed SOW covering the Q4 engagement. We reviewed your milestone template and are happy to bill against the 40/30/30 schedule you proposed.

Key notes:
- PO AR-7789 will be sent via our procurement portal and you should receive PDF in this thread (attached).
- We’ve also attached the signed SOW; the PO references AR-3342 outstanding balance to be invoiced immediately.
- We are requesting Net60 for November and December invoices as a one-time accommodation; we understand Redwood may counter with a hybrid schedule.

Please confirm receipt and whether the credit cap increase to $350k can be provisionally applied upon receiving the PO and CFO letter (Priya will send the letter separately).

Thanks,
Acme Robotics Procurement Team

Attachments: PO_AR-7789.pdf
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@acmerobotics.com, priya.shah@acmerobotics.com
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO AR-7789 and signed SOW for Q4 services

Thanks for the PO and SOW — received and appreciated. Quick update from our side after Evelyn’s provisional review and a short credit call with our finance team: 

- Redwood will provisionally increase Acme’s credit cap to $350,000 for a 30-day period starting on invoice date, contingent on the CFO letter and the PO being in our system (both now received).
- Billing cadence agreed: milestone invoices per the attached template (40% upfront upon PO receipt, 30% at milestone A, 30% on completion).
- For risk mitigation we’ll set primary term to Net45 for the first invoice and Net60 for the second invoice only (as previously proposed). If funding confirmation arrives before Dec 15, we’ll revert to standard Net30 thereafter.
- I’ve initiated a DocuSign update to our T&Cs to reflect the temporary exception and sent the link below — please sign so Finance can finalize the credit increase.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-UpdateTerms
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-2026-0893
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMilestoneBilling

Evelyn — please create the billing route and set the provisional cap. Dylan — let me know if you want to escalate for a longer extension or different terms.

Appreciate the quick coordination — I’ll follow up once the DocuSign is complete and finance confirms the change in our billing system.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
